description: This source file defines a design-time factory for Entity Framework Core, enabling tools to instantiate the application's DbContext during migrations and other design-time tasks.

classes.name: DesignTimeDbContextFactory
classes.description: A sealed class that implements IDesignTimeDbContextFactory for creating instances of AppDbContext during design-time operations.
